alternate-id.description: Alternate session identifier, such as an assumed-role session ARN.

count.description: Number of identical sessions aggregated by the source; omit for an unreported count.

created.description: Session creation time in ISO 8601; convert source epoch milliseconds when necessary.

credential-id.description: Identifier of the credential used, such as an access key ID; exclude secret key material.

expiration-reason.description: Source explanation of why the session ended or expired.

issuer.description: Identity or identifier of the session issuer.

mfa.description: Whether multi-factor authentication was used for this session.

remote.description: Whether this is a remote session.

session-id.description: Session identifier scoped to its issuer; this is metadata rather than a bearer cookie or token value.

session-uuid.description: Universally unique session identifier, when the source supplies a UUID.

terminal.description: Associated terminal, for example a tty or pts identifier.

vpn.description: Whether this is a VPN session.

description: An authenticated session and its issuer, credential identifier, lifetime and authentication properties. One object describes one session or an explicitly aggregated session observation. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/session.
name: authentication-session
